Run the cells in order and note what they print. Cell 1 takes a few minutes. This page is temporary and will be removed.

## 1. Install and load each package

```{webr}
R.version.string
repos <- c("https://bioc.r-universe.dev",
           "https://microbiologyethz.github.io/Methods_in_Microbiomics/wasm",
           "https://repo.r-wasm.org")
pkgs <- c("vegan", "permute", "lme4", "decontam", "DirichletMultinomial",
          "phyloseq", "microbiome", "maaslin3", "ANCOMBC", "ALDEx2", "dada2")

try_pkg <- function(pkg) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  msg <- tryCatch({
    webr::install(pkg, repos = repos, quiet = TRUE)
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
    "ok"
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  data.frame(package = pkg, seconds = round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))),
             result = substr(msg, 1, 200))
}
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pkgs, try_pkg))
res
```

## 2. Do the core functions run?

```{webr}
run <- function(label, expr) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  out <- tryCatch({ force(expr); "ok" }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  cat(sprintf("%-22s %5.1f s  %s\n", label, as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), out))
}

set.seed(1)
counts <- matrix(rnbinom(40 * 300, mu = 50, size = 0.5), nrow = 40,
                 dimnames = list(sprintf("S%02d", 1:40), sprintf("ASV%03d", 1:300)))
meta <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(counts),
                   patient = rep(sprintf("P%02d", 1:20), each = 2),
                   type = rep(c("Sputum", "Throat"), 20),
                   dna = rlnorm(40, 2, 0.5),
                   neg = c(rep(FALSE, 36), rep(TRUE, 4)))

run("vegan adonis2", vegan::adonis2(vegan::vegdist(counts) ~ type, data = meta,
    permutations = permute::how(nperm = 199, blocks = factor(meta$patient))))
run("decontam frequency", decontam::isContaminant(counts, conc = meta$dna, method = "frequency"))
run("decontam prevalence", decontam::isContaminant(counts, neg = meta$neg, method = "prevalence"))
run("DMM k = 1..3", lapply(1:3, function(k) DirichletMultinomial::dmn(counts[, 1:50], k, verbose = FALSE)))
run("maaslin3", maaslin3::maaslin3(as.data.frame(counts), meta, output = tempfile(),
    formula = "~ type + (1 | patient)", plot_summary_plot = FALSE, plot_associations = FALSE,
    save_models = FALSE, verbosity = "ERROR"))
run("ALDEx2", ALDEx2::aldex(t(counts[1:36, ]), meta$type[1:36], mc.samples = 16, verbose = FALSE))
```

## 3. dada2 on its bundled example reads

```{webr}
fq <- sort(list.files(system.file("extdata", package = "dada2"), pattern = "sam.*F.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))
fq
run("plotQualityProfile", print(dada2::plotQualityProfile(fq[1:2])))
filt <- file.path(tempdir(), basename(fq))
run("filterAndTrim", dada2::filterAndTrim(fq, filt, truncLen = 240, maxEE = 2))
run("learnErrors", err <<- dada2::learnErrors(filt, multithread = FALSE, verbose = FALSE))
run("dada", dd <<- dada2::dada(filt, err = err, multithread = FALSE, verbose = FALSE))
```
